text:
taylor_sales: Heads-up — ACME Bank wants a reserved capacity quote. They provided traffic: steady 150 RPS chat, 600 RPS embeddings, daily peak spikes to 1k RPS for 30-45min. SLOs: chat p99 <300ms, embed p99 <200ms. They want reserves + burst credits + KMS. Any blockers?

nate_eng: Quick Qs: avg tokens (in/out)? embed dim? batching behavior?

rachel_se: Also need to know mult-turn ratio and if clients will re-use session ids for KV caching.

taylor_sales: Avg tokens 45 in, 70 out. Embeds 1536-d. Clients batch embeddings occasionally ~batch 10.

sam_infra: Rough mapping: A100-eq gives ~50 RPS/chat for our optimized chat model at low-latency. So steady 150 RPS => ~3 GPUs for chat. Embeddings batched -> high throughput: 600 RPS with batch10 ~2 GPUs. Reserve baseline 5 GPUs. Recommend min_reserve=5, autoscale target buffer 25%, max=15 for spikes. Burst credits to cover peak 1k for short windows.

nate_eng: If we use int8 quant for burst, cost drops ~35% with p99 increase ~10-15ms. Suggest reserve on fp16/quant fp16, burst int8.

rachel_se: Preheat: run KV-warm for 90-180 minutes. Include synthetic script in runbook. Also note KMS: for Dedicated we support AWS/GCP KMS; need key policy for access. Security needs questionnaire answers.

ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: int8 model rollout to canary cluster on 2025-01-10T09:00Z.

security-bot: KMS integration ok. Audit logs retention configurable. VPC peering supported for Dedicated. Will need completed data flow diagram to sign off.

taylor_sales: Pricing question — customer asked delta reserved vs burst per GPU-hour with example numbers.

sam_infra: Back-of-envelope: on-demand ~ $3.00/GPU-hr => reserved ~$1.70/GPU-hr (varies). For steady 5 GPUs reserved plus daily 3-hour burst to 10 GPUs, we'll send a simple spreadsheet calc. I'll attach numbers to the proposal.

nate_eng: Embedding SLO: encourage client batching >=8 or use our batching proxy; reduces p99 significantly.

rachel_se: I'll draft the security answers and preheat/runbook (includes warm script + smoke test) and post before EOD.

taylor_sales: Great — I'll ask ACME Bank for expected daily burst hours and the completed questionnaire. Thanks.

ops-bot: Load test template: {"duration_min":120,"steady":{"chat":150,"embed":600},"peak":{"chat":1000,"embed":1000,"duration_min":45}}
